Allowed origins are configured in `worker/src/index.ts`, inside the `cors()` middleware's `origin` callback (lines ~20–29). Currently permitted:

- `http://localhost:4200` (exact match)
- any `*.pages.dev` subdomain
- any `*.workers.dev` subdomain

To add a new custom domain, edit that `origin` function in `worker/src/index.ts` — add a check like `origin === 'https://yourdomain.com'` or `origin.endsWith('.yourdomain.com')` to the `if` condition (around line 22), so it returns `origin` instead of `null` for the new domain.
